2.200.13
RadialPointer.Style
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The RadialPointer.Style element specifies style properties for a RadialPointer. This element is
optional. This element is of type Style.
The following is the parent element of the RadialPointer.Style element.
Parent elements
RadialPointer
The following is the XML Schema definition of the RadialPointer.Style element.
 <xsd:element name="Style" type="StyleType" minOccurs="0" />
